content.title: MESSAGING & EVENT STREAMING
content.content:
SnapLogic supports all major on-premises messaging and event streaming platforms, operating as both producer and consumer within AH's existing message bus infrastructure.

- **Apache Kafka v4.0+**: Native Kafka Snap Pack. Produces to and consumes from Kafka topics on-premises. Supports key/value serialisation (JSON, Avro, Protobuf), consumer group management, and offset commit. Kafka brokers remain within AH's network.

- **RabbitMQ**: AMQP v0.9.1+ — publish to exchanges and consume from queues, both inbound and outbound. Supports durable queues, message TTL, and dead-letter exchanges. Native Snap Pack ensures persistent connections with automatic reconnection on failures.

- **Solace v10.12+**: Native Snap (Solace Messaging Format) protocol support via the JMS Snap Pack. Publish to and subscribe from Solace topics and queues. Solace is a common message bus in aerospace manufacturing environments.

- **JMS v1.1-1.2**: Generic JMS connector for any JMS-compliant broker (IBM MQ, ActiveMQ, Tibco EMS, etc.). Supports both publish/produce (outbound) and consumer (inbound) modes.

- **MQTT v3.1.1 and v5.0**: Lightweight publish/subscribe protocol for IoT and sensor data use cases — inbound subscribe and outbound publish. A native MQTT Snap enables direct subscription to industrial control (IIoT) or on-premises message brokers.

- **AWS SQS/SNS**: Native Snap Pack for Amazon Web Services queues (SQS) and topics (SNS) — can be used for hybrid integration scenarios (on-premises → cloud or cloud → on-premises). Useful for lift-and-shift strategies.
